summary: LouvorApp backend MVP fully validated. 26/26 pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth (signup leader/member via invite, duplicate email, invalid invite, login success/fail, get/update /me), ministry endpoints, full CRUD for songs/scales/announcements with persistence checks, stats counters, multi-tenant isolation (Leader B cannot see Leader A's data), and 401 on all protected routes without token.

minor.issue: When ministry not found returns empty dict {} with 200 instead of 404 (cosmetic; only reachable if data is corrupted)
If both invite_code AND ministry_name are sent, invite_code takes precedence silently (no validation error). Consider rejecting ambiguous payloads.

action_items: Frontend testing was explicitly skipped per request (testing_type=backend only). Run a separate frontend pass when ready.
Optional hardening: validate signup payload (reject when both invite_code and ministry_name are provided).
Optional: enforce that only leaders can DELETE songs/scales/announcements (currently any authenticated member of the same ministry can delete).
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded dev secret if env var missing — acceptable for MVP but should fail-fast in production.
No role-based authorization: member role can create/delete songs, scales and announcements just like leader. Consider RBAC if this is undesired.
server.py is a single ~420-line file; still manageable but starting to mix concerns (auth, models, routes). Consider splitting if it grows further.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded everywhere via projection {'_id': 0}.
All datetime fields normalized to ISO strings before insert/return — good.
seed_data_creation: Tests create two fresh leaders/ministries (TEST Leader A/B with UUID suffix) plus a member via invite code. All test-created entities are prefixed with 'TEST' for easy cleanup. Demo account (demo@louvor.app) was only used for the initial health login check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid at 100% pass rate. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_louvorapp_backend.py is reusable for regression. For next pass, focus on frontend Expo web preview (login/register screens, tabs: Home/Escalas/Repertório/Avisos/Perfil) using mobile viewport 375x667 and testID selectors.
